notes.cribb-deschamps-hall: Cribb Hall (511-D Fort Hill St.) and DesChamps Hall (511-C) in Clemson's ClemsonBuildings_2025 layer (https://services1.arcgis.com/x5wCko8UnSi4h0CB/arcgis/rest/services/ClemsonBuildings_2025/FeatureServer/0); the pin is between the pair.
notes.the-quad: The Quad is seven fraternity and sorority halls (school data, from housing.clemson.edu/building/the-quad/): OSM Wannamaker, Simpson North and South, Norris, Bowen, Bradley and Donaldson Hall (ways 26996849, 26996872, 26996870, 27511405, 26996858, 26996854, 26967872); the pin is their middle.
notes.douthit-hills-east: Douthit Hills East is buildings E, F and G (housing.clemson.edu/building/douthit-hills-east/); pinned at the middle one, OSM 'Douthit Hills F' (127 Cherry Rd. in the Clemson buildings layer).
notes.douthit-hills: Douthit Hills West is the apartment community's other buildings, A to D on Daniel Dr. in Clemson's ClemsonBuildings_2025 layer (https://services1.arcgis.com/x5wCko8UnSi4h0CB/arcgis/rest/services/ClemsonBuildings_2025/FeatureServer/0) (East is E-G); the pin is the middle of the four.

detours.why: The west-campus halls (Cope, Young, Benet, Geer, Sanders) sit inside a ring of mapped paths that opens only at its corners; walks to the buildings just south (Earle, Advanced Materials, Sirrine, Hunter) and north (Dillard) go out by a corner and round.
The Core Campus and Quad courtyards meet the rest of the mapped path network at only a few points, so walks to Tillman, Godfrey, McAlister and Sloan leave by those links and go round the block.
Schilletter dining hall stands between these halls and Hendrix with no mapped path through, so walks go round it by the road on the east.
